if: tax has been paid in accordance with the demand, detention or confiscation provisions of the Act
then: CONFLICT — both locally held sources block credit on such tax, but name different provisions and this file resolves neither. Source A: tax paid under SECTIONS 74, 129 AND 130. Source B: tax paid under SECTION 74 IN RESPECT OF ANY PERIOD UP TO FINANCIAL YEAR 2023-24
note: The scope difference is material: under source A, tax paid on detention under s.129 or confiscation under s.130 is blocked; under source B those two sections are not named at all and s.74 itself is capped at periods up to financial year 2023-24. Source B footnotes the substitution to Act 15 of 2024 with effect from 1-11-2024. Section 17(5) opens 'Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1) of section 16 and sub-section (1) of section 18', so this block defeats both the s.16(1) entitlement and the s.18(1) special-circumstances credit. Business use does not cure it.
